annotation.title_en: Apply AI: AI-Driven Robotics for Industry: Enabling System Integration and Adoption (IA) (Partnership in AI, Data and Robotics)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Horizon Europe French portal (Ministère de l'enseignement supérieur, de la recherche et de l'espace) reproducing European Commission call topic
annotation.summary_en: French Horizon Europe portal page reproducing a call topic for a €18M Innovation Action on AI-driven robotics system integration under the ADRA partnership. It seeks modular integration frameworks, pilots, digital twins, adoption guides for SMEs, and contributions to open standards and certification pathways.
key_provisions_or_claims: Budget €18M; opens 17 Nov 2026, closes 18 Mar 2027; TRL 4 to 7
Modular integration framework validated in at least three industrial pilots
Step-by-step adoption guide for SMEs including regulatory compliance and certification
Contributions to open standards and certification pathways
Promotes Green AI and energy-efficient robotics; digital twin testbeds for safety validation
